messages:
pagerduty-bot: Pager triggered — metering anomaly (token_count drift) on prod-shard-12. Overages flagged for customers in region us-east-1. Link: https://redwood/incident/INC-2023-338
metrics-oncall: I'm on it, looking at ingest pipeline and emitter offsets. pulling initial counts now.
billing-eng: Seeing duplicate increments from proxy layer. Possible retry storm between proxy and emitter.
metrics-oncall: Querying primary stream: `SELECT count(*) FROM token_events WHERE shard=\'12\' AND ts > now()-interval '1 hour'` — counts look ~3x expected.
core-sre: Any customer-facing alerts?
product-support: We have 18 customers with overage flag email queued, 2 autosuspended. Holding notification.
maya: @billing-eng can we pause overage triggers? we should avoid noisy emails.
billing-eng: Pausing overage alert rule r:billing_overage_us_east via infra console. runbook step: `curl -X POST https://infra/alerts/pause -d '{"rule":"billing_overage_us_east"}'`
metrics-oncall: Root cause appears to be emitter dedup key null after deploy 2023-11-30T02:14Z — retries re-emitted tokens. Rolling back to previous emitter version for shard 12.
pagerduty-bot: Auto-update: rollback started by metrics-oncall.
metrics-oncall: Rollback complete. In-flight correction job enqueued: `python tools/recon_backfill.py --shard 12 --window 60m` — kicking off.
core-sre: Running quick sanity: compare token sums between ingress and ledger. `diff` shows excess ~1.9M tokens in ledger for last hour.
product-support: Customer impact estimate: ~120k tokens billed across 18 customers (spurious). We'll issue credits; need billing list.
billing-eng: Exporting impacted customers: `curl https://billing/api/exports/impacted?shard=12&window=60m` -> s3://recon/impacted-1701357902.csv
maya: Please don't send emails until we verify backfill results. Assign follow-up ticket to billing team.
metrics-oncall: Backfill finished, reconciliation delta reduced to <0.5% — canceling overage flags and scheduling automated credit for impacted customers.
product-support: Drafting notify: "We observed an internal metering issue causing temporary overage flags for some usage. No action required; credits will be applied." Will post after billing confirms credit job.
core-sre: Postmortem owner: metrics-oncall, ETA 48h.
product-support: Thanks all. :heart:
